conclusion: Within this bounded study (10% test-label outliers of magnitude 10, clean training data), OLS (linear) had lower error than the matched training-mean baseline across all executed seeds (7, 19, 31) and all executed metrics (mse, mae, median_absolute_error). The gap direction was consistent in every observation; e.g. mse linear ranged 10.155670419036328 to 10.27158831684568 vs baseline 19.705700590219237 to 23.951894598705938. This is a bounded result for the executed configuration only; no general scientific value is claimed.
limitations: Only seeds 7, 19, and 31 were executed; no other seeds were run.
Only mse, mae, and median_absolute_error were computed; no other metrics were run.
Outlier fraction (0.1), outlier magnitude (10), and clean-training-data setup are fixed; no sensitivity analysis was executed.
Three seeds give a narrow basis; no confidence interval or significance test was executed.
No independent verification was executed; verification_refs is empty.
No claim of general scientific value is made.
